_notes_rules: sites: living_chance = chance per generated system of one living civilization, ruins_chance = of one ruins site (owner: about half / most while a match is one system; back to 1 in 6 / 1 in 4 with a galaxy map). The body is a weighted pick among the system's bodies whose class has a weight (living_weights / ruins_weights), never the colony's landing body, at most one site per body. Living classes need a surface of their own (surfaces.json planets) or a town_maps stand-in (the surface class whose look-only map holds their towns: K and H use Veyra's class L, N uses class M), because only class M and L have surfaces today and ~85% of systems have just one landable body. level_weights: L1..L6 weights per body class (default = the rest); ruins_levels: the level a dead civilization had reached; level_range: how many levels wide the range is before study (the true level is somewhere inside, by the site's seed; clamped to L1..L6). temperament_weights; unified_chance per level (else fractured into nations[0]..nations[1] nations). town_terrain: weights for picking town tiles on the look-only map (coastal_bonus added next to water), town_spacing: the tiles kept between towns (lowered when the map has no room). awareness (0..100, shared by every visitor, only rises): bands (from, id, name), start per level, a satellite seen by L satellite_seen_from_level+ adds satellite_per_min, a ship in orbit seen by L ship_seen_from_level+ ship_per_min, each hidden post post_per_min, a post found post_found at once. study: seconds to finish with only a ship in orbit / a satellite / a post (rates add up). research: points a minute while studying (orbit/satellite, until Study = 1) by level and per hidden post (always), into the player's active surface research (with none active they wait in a bank and go into the next tech). post: factions that may place one (Federation only for now), cost (from the player's stock, like a satellite), max per player, a discovery roll every discovery_minutes of game time at discovery_chance (doubled while awareness is above double_above_awareness); found = awareness + post_found, an incident, Standing + standing_change. standing (Federation players in eras with the Prime Directive only: eras starting at or after prime_directive_from_year): start, max, thresholds of the steps warning / inquiry / relieved / sanctions, recovery_per_min with no incident in the last recovery_after_minutes (up to start), recalled for good at 0 or the recalled_incidents-th incident on one world; inquiry holds the ship for inquiry_hold_seconds, sanctions cut observation research to sanctions_research for sanctions_seconds.
